scope: Read-only search in the existing QuickSurface process for exact native cutter fixture bounding-box byte patterns.
limitations: Only committed readable private regions and exact eight-byte-aligned six-double patterns were examined; failed reads, mapped regions, other alignments and bounding-box padding were not resolved.
Zero hits does not prove absence of a spatial tree or identify its representation.
This did not invoke or mutate the native application and does not establish native facet parity.
